provenance.note: intermediates of synthetic/head-sway-and-finish-drift, recorded at each function boundary `analyze_swing_bundle` already has

score.message: Good tempo - 2.7:1 backswing:downswing (inside the tour range 2.72-4.71:1). Your downswing was 110 ms; at the tour ratio that wants a 299-518 ms backswing, and yours was 300. You swing with a quicker tempo than 90% of 1399 tour swings.
score.name: tempo

score.message: Head sway - 0.56 shoulder-widths of lateral movement to impact. Keep your head centered over the ball (aim under 0.43). That is more head movement than at least 90% of 458 tour swings.
score.name: head_sway

score.message: Balanced finish - the body settles within 0.17 shoulder-widths through the follow-through (held and steady). That is a looser finish than 58% of 458 tour swings.
score.name: finish_balance

score.message: Little hip movement - 0.05 shoulder-widths of lateral hip travel to impact, under the tour range 0.14-0.5. Almost every tour swing moves the hips further into the shot than this. That is less hip travel than at least 90% of 458 tour swings.
score.name: hip_sway

score.message: Steady hips going back - 0.00 shoulder-widths of lateral hip travel to the top (centered over the ball at the top). That is less hip slide going back than at least 90% of 458 tour swings.
score.name: hip_shift_at_top

score.message: Head drifting forward - only 0.51 shoulder-widths of separation between head and hips by impact. The head is travelling toward the target with the hips rather than staying back (tour swings open up 0.14-0.67). That is less head-behind separation than at least 90% of 458 tour swings.
score.name: head_stays_back

rows.detail: backswing:downswing time, from phase instants; frame rate cancels
rows.name: tempo_ratio

rows.detail: motion start -> top, from phase instants; real-time clips only, fps does not cancel
rows.name: backswing_ms

rows.detail: top -> impact, from phase instants; real-time clips only, fps does not cancel
rows.name: downswing_ms

rows.detail: |dx| of ear midpoint, address window -> impact window
rows.name: head_sway_norm

rows.detail: p90 hip-center drift through follow-through
rows.name: finish_balance_norm

rows.detail: |dx| of hip midpoint, address window -> impact window
rows.name: hip_sway_norm

rows.detail: |dx| of hip midpoint, address window -> transition window
rows.name: hip_shift_at_top_norm

rows.detail: signed (head - hips) dx over the impact window; + is image-right, camera-frame — carries a static camera bias, see head_hip_gain_norm
rows.name: head_hip_offset_impact_norm

rows.detail: change in signed (head - hips) dx, address window -> impact window, one shared shoulder-width ruler; + is image-right, camera-frame, handedness resolved when judged
rows.name: head_hip_gain_norm

rows.detail: mean per-frame wrist-to-wrist distance over the address window; mixes x and y, so it carries the frame's pixel aspect where the lateral metrics cancel it
rows.name: hand_separation_norm

rows.detail: signed (wrists - shoulders) dy over the address window, + is hands below shoulders; a y quantity over an x ruler, so it carries the frame's pixel aspect. Not handedness-relative
rows.name: hand_height_norm

rows.detail: signed (wrists - hips) dx over the address window; + is image-right, camera-frame, handedness resolved when judged. x over x, so the frame's pixel aspect cancels
rows.name: hand_offset_from_hips_norm

rows.detail: PROXY: circular-mean angle of the trail wrist-to-index-knuckle vector off image-vertical at address, + is image-right. Two points on one hand, not grip rotation about the shaft
rows.name: trail_hand_roll_deg

rows.detail: Mahalanobis distance of the six metrics as a combination, against 458 face-on tour swings; more unusual than 90% of them. Largest contributor: head_hip_gain_norm
rows.name: tour_joint_distance

rows.detail: distance from the tour swing shape inside the fitted subspace; more unusual than 90% of 415 tour swings
rows.name: tour_trajectory_t2

rows.detail: residual off the tour subspace — shape the basis cannot represent; most of it falls in top->impact. NOT calibrated: it over-flags golfers the basis never saw, so read it beside T2 rather than alone
rows.name: tour_trajectory_q

rows.detail: peak lateral excursion of the hip centre from its address x, over the resampled swing (address -> impact); unsigned, so handedness does not enter it
rows.name: pivot_hip_axis_drift_norm

rows.detail: peak lateral excursion of the shoulder centre from its address x, over the resampled swing (address -> impact); unsigned
rows.name: pivot_shoulder_axis_drift_norm

rows.detail: sample-to-sample roughness of the hip centre's path over the resampled swing; unsigned, 0 is a perfectly smooth path
rows.name: pivot_hip_path_jitter_norm

rows.detail: largest against-the-turn move of the shoulder line between consecutive samples within the backswing (address -> top); magnitude only, 0 is a monotone turn
rows.name: pivot_shoulder_reversal_backswing_deg

rows.detail: largest against-the-turn move of the shoulder line between consecutive samples within the downswing (top -> impact); magnitude only, 0 is a monotone turn
rows.name: pivot_shoulder_reversal_downswing_deg
